predictor_provenance.adaptation: spatial recurrent gates with physical-time-conditioned future evolution
predictor_provenance.reference_equivalence: local climate forecasting adaptation, not original paper benchmark reproduction

protocol.rmse: spatial weighted RMSE per origin and lead, then arithmetic mean over origins
protocol.acc: subtract fixed training climatology, then unweighted spatial mean per field; latitude-weighted correlation per origin
protocol.climatology: checkpoint training temporal mean per grid cell; never evaluation labels
protocol.crps: analytic Gaussian marginal CRPS in physical units, latitude weighted; null for deterministic forecasts
protocol.std: population standard deviation across cases, not confidence interval or seed variation
protocol.undefined_acc: null with valid counts; do not compare ACC on different valid subsets
protocol.aggregate: pool casewise scores over origins and leads within each variable; no mixing physical units

scores.acc_reference: fixed per-grid training temporal mean, not seasonal/day-of-year climatology
scores.aggregation: pool area-weighted squared errors over origins/leads before square root; overlapping origins are not independent

limits: Scores are conditional on finite forecasts; failed origins are explicit. Gaussian uncertainty is marginal, not a coherent stochastic trajectory ensemble.
